locations.note: The game opens as a terrorist attack destroys Chicago and Alex D is evacuated from the Tarsus Academy.
Alex wakes in the Tarsus facility in Seattle and takes faction missions in the city's upper and lower levels.
Alex follows the factions to Cairo and its arcology, investigating ApostleCorp.
In Trier, by the Porta Nigra, Alex reaches the facility the rival factions are fighting over.
Alex goes to Antarctica, to the base where ApostleCorp's secrets are kept.
The finale on Liberty Island, beside the statue's remains, where a surviving node of the pre-Collapse communication network decides which faction rules.

routes.name: Alex D
routes.note: Alex D escapes the destruction of Chicago and follows the factions from Seattle to Cairo, Trier and Antarctica, ending on Liberty Island.
